policy_name: Tier C2 Missing Value & Fallback Policy (Documentation Only)

fallback_rules.behavior_when_missing: Use documented fallback default value below without aborting inference (unless strict_missing_check is set to true in caller).

argumentative_quality.rationale: Neutral baseline score fallback if LLM evaluation omits argumentative quality.

critical_rules_failed.rationale: Assume 0 critical rules failed if Layer 1 check is missing.

experimental_strength.rationale: Neutral baseline score fallback if LLM evaluation omits experimental strength.

methodological_strength.rationale: Neutral baseline score fallback if LLM evaluation omits methodological strength.

overall_quality.rationale: Neutral baseline score fallback if LLM evaluation omits overall quality.

risk_multiplier.rationale: Derived from overall_quality and total_rules_failed; fallback 0.0 if derivation errors.

scope_alignment.rationale: Neutral baseline score fallback if LLM evaluation omits scope alignment.

structural_completeness.rationale: Neutral baseline score fallback if LLM evaluation omits structural completeness.

total_rules_failed.rationale: Assume 0 total rules failed if Layer 1 check is missing.
